verdict.rationale: Missive documents a command bar opened with ⌘/Ctrl+K that runs actions such as snooze and search, and its docs title it as covering keyboard shortcuts. One community user calls it "a proper snappy desktop app," which supports the speed claim. The snooze-shortcut quirk another user reports is a design inconsistency, not evidence that shortcuts are missing. missing for 10: a documented, comprehensive keyboard-shortcut reference, evidence that every action is reachable from the keyboard, and more than one anecdote on interface speed.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: by opening the command bar with ⌘/Ctrl + K and typing "snooze"
Master the command bar: keyboard shortcuts and quick commands.
